## v0.8.2 — BLE session fixes

SSH ignores late replies that do not match the list or run in progress. Find keeps the BLE link up for the whole alert, so the 60 s idle disconnect no longer cuts the phone off. A long G0 press saves an in-progress recording (if it is at least 0.5 s) before rebooting to M5Launcher.

HTTP preset JSON on the phone (headers and body may hold tokens) is stored in encrypted preferences. A plain copy from an older install is moved on the next launch.

Docs match the code: record screen does not switch apps, and GPIO light sleep stays off after the BLE stack has been started.

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.2** (Companion versionCode 4).
